Major Tech Outages Hit Apple, Microsoft, and US Banks

A series of significant technological disruptions affected major companies and services in a single week. Apple experienced widespread outages impacting iCloud, the App Store, and Apple Pay. Concurrently, Microsoft and several US banks also faced technical chaos, leading to service interruptions. This follows a period of instability in the tech sector.
